_about: Suggested AtmospherePreset values for the 새벽 길드 거리 (Dawn Guild street) hub, Blender/town/guild.py. Field names match Assets/_Game/Scripts/Runtime/World/Atmosphere.cs (AtmospherePreset). Colours are Unity Color [r,g,b,a] in 0..1; vectors are [x,y,z] Euler degrees. Ambient colours stay at or below ~0.6 so the scene is not washed out. Not applied automatically: copy the values into the 'town_night' / 'town_dawn' cases of AtmospherePreset.ForTileset.

town_dawn._use: Play view (TownWorld.Initialize with title=false): golden-hour to dusk street light. The key name town_dawn is kept because TownWorld and AtmospherePreset.ForTileset select by it; the values are the dusk ones for the 새벽 길드 거리 brief.

town_night._use: Title shot (TownWorld.Initialize with title=true): evening blue hour over the plaza. Warm lamps, the violet gate and the lit HQ windows carry the light.
